desc: Derive the exact operation-cost formula: for interval `[l..r]`, cost is `sum(max(nums[l..i]) - nums[i])`.
Establish endpoint monotonicity: extending right cannot decrease cost, so valid endpoint ranges can be counted with a sliding window.
Develop and implement the right-to-left sliding-window monotonic-block algorithm with add-left, remove-right, and answer-counting invariants.
Run the implementation against both supplied examples and brute-force-check it on exhaustive small arrays to confirm the deque invariants and outputs.
